newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba's Gaddum - Sharp rise in DAX to get attention.
newsitem.headline: Buba's Gaddum - Sharp rise in DAX to get attention.

text.p: Bundesbank deputy president Johann Gaddum said on Thursday that the sharp rise in Germany's DAX share index in the first half of 1997 would receive special attention in discussions at the bank.

Gaddum, speaking at a news conference, also said the issue of M3 money supply, which the central bank uses as a key early inflation indicator when setting monetary policy, would also be dicussed at the Bundesbank's next council meeting. Market development would also be topic of debate, he said.
